title: The armadillo-repeat domain of plakophilin 1 binds the C-terminal sterile alpha motif (SAM) of p73.
authors: Neira, Jose L; Rizzuti, Bruno; Ortega-Alarcon, David; Giudici, A Marcela; Abian, Olga; Farez-Vidal, Maria Esther; Velazquez-Campoy, Adrian
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. General subjects
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物物理实验与分子对接/模拟研究p73转录因子SAM结构域与PKP1臂重复结构域的蛋白-蛋白结合，虽涉及转录因子但非TF-DNA互作，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面建模，故给5分。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Plakophilin 1 (PKP1) is a component of desmosomes, which are key structural components for cell-cell adhesion, and can also be found in other cell locations. The p53, p63 and p73 proteins belong to the p53 family of transcription factors, playing crucial roles in tumour suppression. The alpha-splice variant of p73 (p73alpha) has at its C terminus a sterile alpha motif (SAM); such domain, SAMp73, is involved in the interaction with other macromolecules. METHODS: We studied the binding of SAMp73 with the armadillo domain of PKP1 (ARM-PKP1) in the absence and the presence of 100 mM NaCl, by using several biophysical techniques, namely fluorescence, far-ultraviolet circular dichroism (CD), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), and molecular docking and simulations. RESULTS: Association was observed between the two proteins, with a dissociation constant of ~5 muM measured by ITC and fluorescence in the absence of NaCl. The binding region of SAMp73 involved residues of the so-called "middle-loop-end-helix" binding region (i.e., comprising the third helix, together with the C terminus of the second one, and the N-cap of the fourth), as shown by (15)N, (1)H- HSQC-NMR spectra. Molecular modelling provided additional information on the possible structure of the binding complex. CONCLUSIONS: This newly-observed interaction could have potential therapeutic relevance in the tumour pathways where PKP1 is involved, and under conditions when there is a possible inactivation of p53. GENERAL SIGNIFICANCE: The discovery of the binding between SAMp73 and ARM-PKP1 suggests a functional role for their interaction, including the possibility that SAMp73 could assist PKP1 in signalling pathways.
abstract_zh: 背景：Plakophilin 1 (PKP1) 是桥粒（desmosomes）的组成部分，桥粒是细胞间粘附的关键结构组件，PKP1 也可存在于其他细胞位置。p53、p63 和 p73 蛋白属于 p53 转录因子家族，在肿瘤抑制中发挥关键作用。p73 的 α-剪接变体（p73alpha）在其 C 末端含有一个无菌 α 基序（sterile alpha motif, SAM）；该结构域 SAMp73 参与与其他大分子的相互作用。方法：我们利用多种生物物理技术，即荧光、远紫外圆二色光谱（CD）、核磁共振（NMR）、等温滴定量热法（ITC）以及分子对接和模拟，研究了 SAMp73 与 PKP1 的 armadillo 结构域（ARM-PKP1）在无 NaCl 和存在 100 mM NaCl 条件下的结合。结果：观察到两种蛋白质之间的结合，在无 NaCl 条件下，通过 ITC 和荧光测得的解离常数约为 5 μM。SAMp73 的结合区域涉及所谓的“中环-末端-螺旋”结合区（即包含第三螺旋，连同第二螺旋的 C 末端，以及第四螺旋的 N 端帽）的残基，如 (15)N, (1)H-HSQC-NMR 谱所示。分子建模提供了关于结合复合物可能结构的额外信息。结论：这种新观察到的相互作用可能在 PKP1 涉及的肿瘤通路中，以及在 p53 可能失活的条件下，具有潜在的治疗相关性。一般意义：SAMp73 与 ARM-PKP1 之间结合的发现表明其相互作用具有功能作用，包括 SAMp73 可能协助 PKP1 参与信号通路的可能性。
